description: Defines the FileHistory entity class representing file history records with metadata such as file size, dates, and download count, mapped to the FILE_HISTORY database table.

classes.name: FileHistory
classes.description: Entity class for file history records, including fields for IDs, dates, store association, file size, and download count.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the primary key ID of the file history record.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the primary key ID of the file history record.

methods.name: getFileId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the file.

methods.name: setFileId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the file.

methods.name: getFilesize
methods.description: Returns the size of the file.

methods.name: setFilesize
methods.description: Sets the size of the file.

methods.name: getDateAdded
methods.description: Returns the date the file was added, cloning the date object for safety.

methods.name: setDateAdded
methods.description: Sets the date the file was added, cloning the input date for safety.

methods.name: getDateDeleted
methods.description: Returns the date the file was deleted, cloning the date object.

methods.name: setDateDeleted
methods.description: Sets the date the file was deleted, cloning the input date.

methods.name: getAccountedDate
methods.description: Returns the accounted date, cloning the date object.

methods.name: setAccountedDate
methods.description: Sets the accounted date, cloning the input date.

methods.name: getDownloadCount
methods.description: Returns the number of times the file has been downloaded.
